text:
Ana C: Quick heads-up — want to tighten our competitive narrative for the April webinar and the benchmark blog. Goal: 2-3 sharp claims vs cloud AI platforms + infra vendors that map to buyer pains (latency predictability, cost per request, rollout safety).
Sam G: Love it. Can we surface a short checklist that SDRs can use in the first 30s of a convo?
Devin R: Proposed checklist (working):
- Ask if they prioritize latency SLOs or cost caps
- Ask about multi-env parity (hosted vs private)
- Probe current fallbacks (how do they handle model outages)
Mira K: Those map well to our differentiators. For the webinar hook, suggest: "Learn how to make inference predictable — even when models change." short, benefit-first.
Jordan L: For the benchmark post, can we show a two-column matrix: Cloud API vs Managed infra vs Redwood Dedicated? Keep it visual and call out unit economics on sample workloads.
Ana C: Yes. Also need a tiny soundbite for inbound routing: if lead mentions "benchmark" or "latency" or "SLA" route to AE-team-growth; if mentions "on-prem" or "VPC" route to Enterprise-ops.
Devin R: Draft routing rules for ops-bot (can someone paste into workspace):
```
if text contains any_of(["benchmark","latency","SLA"]) -> tag:growth; route:#sales-ae
if text contains any_of(["on-prem","VPC","air-gapped"]) -> tag:enterprise; route:#sales-enterprise
if text contains "cost per token" -> tag:pricing; route:#revops
```
Sam G: Nice. Add a fallback route for demo requests -> #solutions.
Mira K: Messaging iteration idea: run 3 soundbite variants in paid ads + webinar landing page A/B — measure CTR + demo requests. Variants:
A) "Predictable latency, lower unit cost"
B) "Same API everywhere: hosted, dedicated, private"
C) "Keep apps online when models change"
Jordan L: For battlecard copy, include 1-liners to rebut common claims from cloud AI platforms:
- Claim: "We have the largest models" -> Rebuttal: "Model size ≠ predictable inference. Serving controls, routing and smart caching drive latency & cost in production."
- Claim: "Managed API is easiest" -> Rebuttal: "Easiest today can be costly tomorrow — show a 6-month cost projection on bursty workloads."
Ana C: Can someone take the lead on creating a one-pager for sales by end of week? Also need an internal playbook snippet for SDRs (30s opener + routing checklist).
Sam G: I can do the one-pager. Will draft and share by Thursday.
Devin R: I'll implement the ops-bot routing rules and add tags. Expect PR by Friday.
Mira K: I'll set up the A/B variants for the landing page and coordinate with paid.
Jordan L: I'll sketch the visual matrix for the benchmark post and the slide for the webinar.
ops-bot: Reminder: #marketing sync in 20 minutes. :bell:
Ana C: Awesome — thanks team. Quick ask: Jordan, include a tiny sample graph (cost vs QPS) so sales can point to concrete numbers in calls.
Jordan L: Yup — will do a simple normalized chart and include sample assumptions in the notes.
Sam G: Tagging this doc: https://redwood.app/internal/marketing/battlecard-drafts — leave comments there. :thumbsup:
Ana C: Perfect. Meeting follow-up: we'll review drafts in next Monday's creative review.
Sam G: +1
Devin R: +1
Mira K: +1 :rocket:
